methods.label: Take one half
methods.explanation: Because \(0.5\) is one half, multiplying by \(0.5\) takes half of the other factor. The number \(1.2\) is \(12\) tenths, and half of \(12\) tenths is \(6\) tenths. Therefore, \(1.2\times0.5=0.6\).
methods.levelReason: Halving uses unit fractions, a basic division fact, and decimal place value, all within Grade 5 scope.
